title: ui-kirk: compose KirkCompilationPhase component
description: Compose the KirkCompilationPhase component that orchestrates the Kirk compilation UI experience. Integrates compilation progress display, log viewer, and action controls into a unified component managing the compilation workflow.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the Kirk compilation phase with progress and controls
THE SYSTEM SHALL manage compilation lifecycle through the component

event_driven.trigger: WHEN Kirk compilation phase becomes active
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL initialize compilation and display progress component
THE SYSTEM SHALL enable transition to locked phase
THE SYSTEM SHALL abort compilation and return to preview phase

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT proceed to locked phase
unwanted.because: Only successful compilations should produce locked artifacts

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT leave compilation process orphaned
unwanted.because: Background processes must be properly cleaned up

preconditions: Compilation progress component must be ready
Validated artifacts must be available from preview phase
postconditions: Compilation phase displays complete workflow UI
Progress is tracked and displayed throughout compilation
Phase transitions correctly on completion or cancellation
invariants: Compilation cannot be restarted without returning to preview
Cancel action is available until compilation completes
Phase state reflects actual compilation state

happy: Given Kirk phase is active, when component mounts, then compilation starts automatically with progress visible
Given compilation succeeds, when complete, then proceed to locked button is enabled
Given compilation in progress, when user clicks cancel, then compilation aborts and returns to preview
error: Given compilation fails, when error occurs, then error message is shown with retry option
Given compilation service unavailable, when phase activates, then service error is displayed
Given artifacts invalid for compilation, when compilation starts, then validation error is shown
